title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
snippet: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S. and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.

title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
snippet: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
snippet: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.
